Skilled in driving risk controls, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives while leading teams and training 250+ associates across global operations. Seeking to drive enterprise-scale operational transformation and process excellence.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK HISTORY
Process Excellence Manager
May 2026 – Present
Founding Years Learning Solution (KLAY Preschools & Daycare), Bengaluru, India
Own end-to-end Incident and Escalation Management for the South region (and Incident Management
pan-India (120 centers)), driving Investigation Quality Review, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) tracking against defined SLA and TAT norms.
Led a structured gap-analysis review of the Incident Management process across the center network,
partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to identify process breakdowns and deliver findings to senior leadership.
Authored and drove stakeholder sign-off on pan-India Standard Operating Procedures, including a parent vaccination-declaration and indemnity SOP and a referral-reward fast-track processing SOP, aligning teams across Operations, Finance, and Marketing.
Built standardized Excel-based reporting frameworks tracking escalation and incident metrics (per-100- enrollment rates, TAT compliance, CAPA closure) across regions, cities, and centers, replacing manual data dumps with structured, insight-driven reporting.
Designed a standardized incident-investigation documentation framework, from fact-finding
questionnaires through final investigation reports, adopted network-wide for consistent, audit-
ready reporting.
Designed and launched a repair & maintenance ticketing system piloted across 60 centers in the South
region, featuring role-based access control, standardized issue categorization with criticality scoring,
automated TAT calculation, and a configurable escalation matrix — eliminating manual, spreadsheet- based tracking.
Process Excellence Manager
Dec 2025 – Apr 2026
Acko General Insurance, Bengaluru, India
Conducted end-to-end process analysis of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle, identified gaps in finance approval workflows, and implemented automated Google Sheets solutions with trigger-based tracking, reducing manual follow-ups by 40% and strengthening process governance and KPIs.
Led and mentored a team of 4 Process Excellence specialists, driving business transformation initiatives, managing continuous improvement projects, and tracking performance metrics aligned with organizational objectives.
Delivered significant cost avoidance by developing an internal Inventory Management System using AI- driven prompt engineering, eliminating dependency on legacy/external tools.
Led Value Stream Mapping (VSM) initiatives across ACKO Drive service centers to identify operational bottlenecks, improve repair lifecycle TAT, and enhance service delivery efficiency.
Designed and implemented end-to-end SOPs for after-hours services, enabling operational continuity, audit readiness, and quality assurance compliance.
Strengthened operational governance through process documentation, internal controls, and risk mitigation strategies aligned with business and compliance requirements.
Conducted manpower analysis and defined minimum headcount requirements; implemented zoning and cross-zone dynamic workforce allocation, reducing 11 headcount across top 8 zones and improving productivity by 10%.
Senior Compliance Associate
May 2020 – Nov 2025
Amazon, Bengaluru, India
Built frameworks to promote a culture of continuous improvement across operations; trained and
mentored 250+ team members on Lean Six Sigma and Yellow Belt projects using AI tools like ChatGPT
and Gemini.
Led automation projects using AI insights, prompt engineering, and workflow automation, reducing
manual work by 35 minutes per associate per day and enabling FTE optimization.
Developed a Python-based automated communication tool to send auto-responses and close cases,
improving resolution time and delivering about $800,000 in annual cost savings.
Delivered 8 Lean process improvement projects using DMAIC methodology and AI-supported data
analysis, improving seller response time by 30% and increasing overall operational efficiency by 25%.
Designed and implemented an internal audit framework to standardize decision-making across 7 global
products, improving quality control and ensuring SLA compliance.
Led Value Stream Mapping initiatives to identify process bottlenecks, improve workflow efficiency, and
enhance service delivery performance.
Performed data analysis using Excel, internal tools, and AI-based insights to identify defect trends; applied FMEA risk assessment across operations in 12 countries, improving process quality and reliability.
Relationship Manager, Banking Operations
Apr 2017 – May 2020
ICICI Bank, Bengaluru, India
Managed SWIFT communications and international transactions with Nostro/Vostro banks, ensuring regulatory compliance, transaction accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Performed end-to-end compliance checks including AML, OFAC, KYC/CIP, and BSA using tools like World-Check to identify risks and strengthen internal controls.
Maintained audit-ready documentation and conducted QA reviews on transaction files; coached team members on compliance standards and process adherence.
Tracked funds from Nostro accounts within defined SLAs, ensuring compliance with FEMA and RBI regulatory guidelines for all transactions.
Prepared Management Information (MI) reports on financial crime risks and monitored contract-certainty processes to ensure quality control and governance.
